set.body:
Deliverable: docs/verification/first-level-identity-acceptance.md plus a machine-readable companion if the existing report tooling benefits from one. Use the epic's nine global criteria and the five phase acceptance lists; preserve their wording and scope.
For each criterion record current public API/source path, owning module, exact shared/JVM/JS suite and test/scenario name, external fixture/receipt where parity is claimed, command, current status, and source candidate when executed. Start from DesignSchema, FmriModel/DesignBlock, FitPlan, StructuralHypotheses/DSL, response preparation provenance, run/fixed-effects APIs, the DMS DSL scenario and estimates/fit-estimates bridge. Record the new matrix-ownership regression. The DMS construction must remain the documentation source.
Use explicit not_run/missing/blocked statuses until fresh evidence exists; historical closed tasks are pointers, not test results. Do not expand into optional ProfileHrf features, group estimator research, or a new result hierarchy. Missing original requirements become a narrow linked defect, never silent accepted caveats.
Acceptance: another engineer can resolve every cited file and execute every command; each global criterion and phase obligation is covered or explicitly blocked. Run documentation synchronization and manifest validation. Before closing this task, verify mapping with current sources; full numerical execution/status updates belong to P4.4j.
set.title: P4.4h: map every scientific-identity acceptance criterion to current executable evidence
